purpose: Route substantive publications and authoritative technical records discovered while extending raw-hit coverage through 33925, 93452, 94235, 92543, 52234, 52423 and 54322, while preserving their identifier/page occurrences as controls rather than physical Glob evidence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Mirrors, alternate database records and repeated landing pages for the same work are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Page numbers, DOI/PII components, CVE numbers, grant identifiers, postal codes, computational job IDs and state-count integers are not Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity under the declared evidence gates.

sources.title: Two-Dimensional Defective MoO3-x Layers: Formation of a Magneli-Type Nanophase
sources.note: Use reduction-driven defect accommodation and nanoscale Magneli-phase formation as an oxide-defect/material-state benchmark. 33925 is the terminal article page.

sources.note: Use the combined temperature-dependent Mossbauer and magnetic-susceptibility validation pattern for spin-state assignment. 93452 is a PII component.

sources.title: Effect of pyrolytic carbon addition on the structural and optical properties of TiO2 composite thin films
sources.note: Use Raman, SEM/EDS, ellipsometry and UV-Vis as a multimodal thin-film characterization benchmark. 92543 is DOI metadata.

sources.title: Noble Metal Aerogels

sources.title: Oxygen Self-Doping Bi2S3@C Spheric Successfully Enhanced Long-Term Performance in Lithium-Ion Batteries
sources.note: Use oxygen self-doping plus sulfur-vacancy defect engineering as a battery-material kinetics/stability benchmark. 52423 is the article start page.

sources.title: Imaging-Guided Photoacoustic Immunotherapy Based on the Polydopamine-Functionalized Black Phosphorus Nanocomposites
sources.note: Use photoacoustic imaging/material-functionalization architecture as a sensing reference. 54322 is the article start page.

sources.title: CVE-2025-54322
sources.note: Use as a security-hardening/advisory-feed input and as a namespace collision control. 54322 is the CVE numeric identifier, not a physical quantity.

information_updates.finding: The frontier states demonstrate strong namespace multiplicity: 52234 independently starts at least two ACS materials papers; 52423 occurs as both an article start page and research-fund identifier; 54322 occurs as an ACS start page, CVE number and computational job ID.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Multi-namespace recurrence is evidence about corpus collision behavior only and contributes zero automatic physical Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: The TiO2/PyC study provides a reusable multimodal characterization stack combining Raman spectroscopy, microscopy/compositional analysis, ellipsometry and UV-Vis optical response.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Methodology value is independent of the 92543 DOI collision.

information_updates.finding: The O-Bi2S3@C work provides a defect-engineering benchmark in which oxygen self-doping and sulfur vacancies are used to alter active-site density, conductivity, ion transport and cycling behavior.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 52423 is bibliographic pagination, not a measured battery quantity.
